name: gethostname
description: gethostname() retrieves the hostname associated with the calling process's UTS namespace and stores it in the provided buffer. It returns the null-terminated hostname, truncating if necessary to fit the buffer size, with no error indicated for truncation.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Buffer to store the null-terminated hostname

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the buffer in bytes

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: len is smaller than the actual size of the hostname

versions: POSIX.1-2008; Linux since 1.0 with HOST_NAME_MAX of 64 bytes
